name: KromiumNavigationInterceptor
summary: Functional interface to intercept and override browser navigation.

methods.name: shouldOverrideUrlLoading
methods.signature: fun shouldOverrideUrlLoading(url: String, isRedirect: Boolean): Boolean
methods.description: Called before browser navigation occurs. Returns true to cancel the navigation, false to allow it.

parameters.name: isRedirect
parameters.description: True if this navigation is the result of a server or client redirect.
